metadata.name: chief-of-staff
metadata.description: Personal communication chief of staff that triages email, Slack, LINE, and Messenger. Classifies messages into 4 tiers (skip/info_only/meeting_info/action_required), generates draft replies, and enforces post-send follow-through via hooks. Use when managing multi-channel communication workflows.
metadata.tools: Read, Grep, Glob, Bash, Edit, Write
